drawableXml.name: activity_panel
drawableXml.body:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<shape xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android"
    android:shape="rectangle">
    <solid android:color="#01000000" />
    <size android:width="2dp" android:height="2dp" />
</shape>

drawableXml.name: primary_action_state
drawableXml.body:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<selector xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android">
    <item android:state_pressed="true">
        <shape android:shape="rectangle">
            <solid android:color="#F8FAFC" />
            <stroke android:width="1dp" android:color="#38BDF8" />
            <corners android:radius="18dp" />
            <padding android:left="10dp" android:top="8dp" android:right="10dp" android:bottom="8dp" />
        </shape>
    </item>
    <item>
        <shape android:shape="rectangle">
            <gradient android:startColor="#60A5FA" android:endColor="#2563EB" android:angle="270" />
            <stroke android:width="1dp" android:color="#1D4ED8" />
            <corners android:radius="18dp" />
            <padding android:left="10dp" android:top="8dp" android:right="10dp" android:bottom="8dp" />
        </shape>
    </item>
</selector>

drawableXml.name: media_progress_track
drawableXml.body:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<layer-list xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android">
    <item android:id="@android:id/background">
        <shape><solid android:color="#33000000" /><size android:height="4dp" /><corners android:radius="2dp" /></shape>
    </item>
    <item android:id="@android:id/secondaryProgress">
        <clip><shape><solid android:color="#94A3B8" /><size android:height="4dp" /><corners android:radius="2dp" /></shape></clip>
    </item>
    <item android:id="@android:id/progress">
        <clip><shape><solid android:color="#EF4444" /><size android:height="4dp" /><corners android:radius="2dp" /></shape></clip>
    </item>
</layer-list>

layoutXml.name: ticket_record_row
layoutXml.body:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<LinearLayout xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android"
    android:orientation="horizontal"
    android:layout_width="match_parent"
    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
    android:padding="4dp"
    android:background="@drawable/status_card_panel">
    <TextView android:id="@+id/ticket_id_{{index}}" android:text="ID" android:layout_width="0dp" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_weight="1" />
    <TextView android:id="@+id/ticket_title_{{index}}" android:text="Record" android:layout_width="0dp" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_weight="2" />
    <TextView android:id="@+id/ticket_state_{{index}}" android:text="Ready" android:layout_width="0dp" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_weight="1" android:textSize="12sp" />
</LinearLayout>

layoutXml.name: login_session_panel
layoutXml.body:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<LinearLayout xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android"
    android:orientation="vertical"
    android:layout_width="match_parent"
    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
    android:padding="8dp"
    android:background="@drawable/status_card_panel">
    <TextView android:id="@+id/session_title_{{index}}" android:text="Session" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:textSize="14sp" />
    <EditText android:id="@+id/session_name_{{index}}" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:hint="Account" android:inputType="text" />
    <EditText android:id="@+id/session_token_{{index}}" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:hint="Token" android:inputType="textPassword" />
    <Button android:id="@+id/session_action_{{index}}" android:text="Continue" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:background="@drawable/primary_action_state" />
</LinearLayout>

layoutXml.name: alarm_schedule_panel
layoutXml.body:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<LinearLayout xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android"

    <Button android:id="@+id/alarm_done_{{index}}" android:text="Done" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:background="@drawable/primary_action_state" />
</LinearLayout>

layoutXml.name: progress_state_panel
layoutXml.body:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<LinearLayout xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android"

    <TextView android:id="@+id/progress_label_{{index}}" android:text="Loading" android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_gravity="center" android:textSize="12sp" />
</LinearLayout>

layoutXml.name: message_empty_state
layoutXml.body:

layoutXml.name: loading_dialog_panel
layoutXml.body:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<LinearLayout xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android"
    android:layout_width="wrap_content"
    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
    android:minWidth="160dp"
    android:minHeight="64dp"

    <ProgressBar android:id="@+id/loading_progress_{{index}}" android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" />

</LinearLayout>

layoutXml.name: toast_message_panel
layoutXml.body:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<LinearLayout xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android"
    android:layout_width="wrap_content"
    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
    android:gravity="center"
    android:orientation="vertical">
    <FrameLayout android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:background="@drawable/loading_surface_panel">
        <LinearLayout android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:orientation="vertical" android:padding="10dp">
            <TextView android:id="@+id/toast_title_{{index}}" android:text="Success" android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:textSize="15sp" android:textColor="#0F172A" />
            <TextView android:id="@+id/toast_body_{{index}}" android:text="Message accepted" android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginTop="4dp" android:textSize="12sp" android:textColor="#475569" />
        </LinearLayout>
    </FrameLayout>
</LinearLayout>

layoutXml.name: title_bar_panel
layoutXml.body:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<RelativeLayout xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android"
    android:id="@+id/title_bar_{{index}}"
    android:layout_width="match_parent"
    android:layout_height="48dp"
    android:background="@drawable/toolbar_state_bar">
    <TextView android:id="@+id/title_back_{{index}}" android:layout_width="48dp" android:layout_height="match_parent" android:layout_alignParentLeft="true" android:gravity="center" android:text="Back" android:textColor="#FFFFFF" android:textSize="12sp" />
    <TextView android:id="@+id/title_text_{{index}}" android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="match_parent" android:layout_centerInParent="true" android:gravity="center" android:text="Channel" android:textColor="#FFFFFF" android:textSize="16sp" />

layoutXml.name: photo_grid_cell
layoutXml.body:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<RelativeLayout xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android"
    android:layout_width="match_parent"
    android:layout_height="match_parent"
    android:gravity="center"
    android:background="@drawable/photo_cell_overlay">
    <FrameLayout android:id="@+id/photo_frame_{{index}}" android:layout_width="88dp" android:layout_height="88dp" android:layout_centerInParent="true" android:background="@drawable/status_card_panel">
        <TextView android:id="@+id/photo_label_{{index}}" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="match_parent" android:gravity="center" android:text="Photo" android:textSize="12sp" android:textColor="#334155" />
    </FrameLayout>
    <TextView android:id="@+id/photo_close_{{index}}" android:layout_width="24dp" android:layout_height="24dp" android:layout_alignRight="@id/photo_frame_{{index}}" android:layout_alignTop="@id/photo_frame_{{index}}" android:gravity="center" android:text="x" android:textSize="12sp" android:textColor="#FFFFFF" android:background="#66000000" />
</RelativeLayout>

layoutXml.name: dialog_confirm_panel

    android:background="@drawable/loading_surface_panel">
    <TextView android:id="@+id/dialog_title_{{index}}" android:text="Confirm" android:gravity="center" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:padding="12dp" android:textSize="16sp" android:textColor="#0F172A" />
    <TextView android:id="@+id/dialog_content_{{index}}" android:text="Continue with this action" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:gravity="center" android:padding="12dp" android:textSize="14sp" android:textColor="#475569" />

layoutXml.name: media_progress_panel
layoutXml.body:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<LinearLayout xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android"
    android:layout_width="match_parent"
    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
    android:orientation="vertical"
    android:padding="8dp"
    android:background="@drawable/status_card_panel">
    <TextView android:id="@+id/media_title_{{index}}" android:text="Media" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:textSize="13sp" android:textColor="#0F172A" />
    <ProgressBar android:id="@+id/media_progress_{{index}}" style="?android:attr/progressBarStyleHorizontal" android:progressDrawable="@drawable/media_progress_track" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="6dp" android:layout_marginTop="6dp" />

pageBodies.body:
return PhysicalModel(
  color: const Color(0xFFF5F5F5),
  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular({{padding}}),
  clipBehavior: Clip.antiAlias,
  elevation: {{padding}} * 0.3,
  shadowColor: const Color(0x33000000),
  child: Container(
    width: {{width}},
    height: {{height}},
    padding: EdgeInsets.all({{padding}}),
    child: Column(
      mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.center,
      children: [
        Container(
          width: {{width}} * 0.3,
          height: {{padding}} * 0.6,
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            color: const Color(0xFFDC59EE),
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular({{padding}} * 0.3),
          ),
        ),
        SizedBox(height: {{padding}} * 0.4),
        Container(
          width: {{width}} * 0.5,
          height: {{padding}} * 0.6,
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            color: const Color(0xFFA34EFA),
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular({{padding}} * 0.3),
          ),
        ),
      ],
    ),
  ),
);
